clues.text: This towering coaster stands 206 feet tall, reaches a blistering top speed of 75 mph, and features 3 inversions.
Manufactured by Rocky Mountain Construction (RMC), this massive hybrid powerhouse made its debut in 2019.
Thrills await international travelers looking for this record-breaking coaster, as it operates in the country of Poland.
Unlike previous hybrid conversions, this ride made history as the very first coaster to be built from the ground up using RMC's patented I-Box Track.
Appropriate for a ride built with thousands of wooden beams, its one-word name is Polish for "splinter".

evidence.quote: Zadra (English: Splinter) is a steel roller coaster located at Energylandia in Zator, Poland.
It is the first coaster to be built from the ground up using the I-Box Track, rather than using an existing structure.
